```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor) 
library(naniar)
library(here)
options(scipen = 99)
```

```{r}
TedsA <- load(here("data/tedsa_puf_2023.rdata"))

teds_a <- get(TedsA) %>%
  clean_names()

teds_hi <- teds_a %>%
  filter(stfips == 15)
```

#read in our data and used stfips to filter by Hawaii #Hawaii had 869 patient data entries

Decode Age

```{r}
teds_hi <- teds_hi %>%
  mutate(age_lbl = factor(age,
                               levels = 1:12,
                               labels = c("12-14 years ", 
                                          "15-17 years",
                                          "18-20 years",
                                          "21-24 years",
                                          "25-29 years",
                                          "30-34 years",
                                          "35-39 years",
                                          "40-44 years",
                                          "45-49 years",
                                          "50-54 years",
                                          "55-64 years",
                                          "65 years and older")))
```

#In this chunk, we organized our age groups into clusters

Decode ALCDRUG

```{r}
teds_hi <- teds_hi %>%
  mutate(alcdrug_lbl = factor(alcdrug,
                          levels = 0:3,
                          labels = c("None", 
                                     "Alcohol only",
                                     "Other Drugs Only",
                                     "Alcohol and other drugs")))
```


```{r}
teds_d <- load(here("data/tedsd_puf_2023.rdata"))

teds_d <- get(teds_d) %>%
  clean_names()
```

```{r}
teds_d <- teds_d %>%
  filter(frstuse1 != -9 & noprior != -9) %>%
  mutate(frstuse_lbl = factor(frstuse1,
                               levels = 1:7,
                               labels = c("11 and under",
                                          "12-14 years",
                                          "15-17 years",
                                          "18-20 years",
                                          "21-24 years",
                                          "25-29 years",
                                          "30 and older")))
```

```{r}

#Frstuse1(x) vs NOPRIOR(2)

teds_d %>%
  group_by(frstuse_lbl) %>%
  summarise(pct_prior = mean(noprior == 1)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = frstuse_lbl, y = pct_prior, group = 1)) +
  geom_line(color = "blue4", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(y = "% with prior treatment episode", x = "Age at first use")


## amber updated line
teds_d %>%
  filter(noprior != -9, frstuse1 != -9, age != -9, stfips == 15) %>%
  mutate(age_adm = case_when(
    age <= 4 ~ "Under 25",
    age <= 7 ~ "25–39",
    TRUE     ~ "40+")) %>%
  group_by(age_adm, frstuse_lbl) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            pct_prior = mean(noprior == 1),
            se = sqrt(pct_prior * (1 - pct_prior) / n),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = frstuse_lbl, y = pct_prior,
             color = age_adm, group = age_adm)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = pct_prior - 1.96 * se,
                      ymax = pct_prior + 1.96 * se)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "HI only", y = "% with prior treatment episode", x = "Age at first use",
       color = "Age at admission")

```

How does Hawaii treatment centers compare with the rest of the country?

```{r}
teds_d <- teds_d %>%
  filter(reason != -9) %>%
  mutate(completed = reason == 1,
         group = if_else(stfips == 15, "Hawaii", "Rest of U.S."))

teds_d %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(pct_completed = mean(completed) * 100)


```

```{r}
teds_d %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(pct_completed = mean(completed) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, y = pct_completed, fill = group)) +
  geom_col(color = "black") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% treatment completed",
       title = "Treatment completion rate: Hawaii vs. rest of U.S.") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
teds_d %>%
  filter(reason != -9) %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(stfips == 15, "Hawaii", "Rest of U.S."),
         reason_lbl = factor(reason,
                              levels = 1:7,
                              labels = c("Completed", "Dropped out",
                                         "Terminated by facility",
                                         "Transferred", "Incarcerated",
                                         "Death", "Other"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = group, fill = reason_lbl)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "black") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of discharges", fill = "Discharge reason",
       title = "Discharge outcomes: Hawaii vs. rest of U.S.")
```

Hawaii's drug distribution?

```{r}
teds_d %>%
  filter(sub1 != -9, stfips == 15) %>%
  mutate(sub1_lbl = factor(sub1,
                            levels = c(10, 2, 4, 5, 7, 3, 19, 13, 11, 12),
                            labels = c("Methamphetamine/speed", "Alcohol",
                                       "Marijuana/hashish", "Heroin",
                                       "Other opiates/synthetics", "Cocaine/crack",
                                       "Other drugs", "Benzodiazepines",
                                       "Other amphetamines", "Other stimulants"))) %>%
  count(sub1_lbl) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sub1_lbl, pct), y = pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "blue4", color = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of Hawaii admissions",
       title = "Primary substance at admission, Hawaii (2023)")
```

```{r}
library(ggsankey)
library(paletteer)

teds_dr <- teds_d |> 
  mutate(reason_lbl = factor(reason,
                             levels = 1:7,
                             labels = c("Completed", "Dropped out",
                                        "Terminated by facility",
                                        "Transferred", "Incarcerated",
                                        "Death", "Other"))) |> 
  mutate(service_lbl = factor(services, levels = 1:8, labels = 
                                c("Detox, 24-hour, hospital inpatient",
                                  "Detox, 24-hour, free-standing residential", 
                                  "Rehab/residential, hospital (non-detox)", 
                                  "Rehab/residential, short term (30 days or fewer)", 
                                  "Rehab/residential, long term (more than 30 days)", 
                                  "Ambulatory, intensive outpatient", 
                                  "Ambulatory, non-intensive outpatient",
                                  "Ambulatory, detoxification"))) |> 
  mutate(alcdrug_lbl = factor(alcdrug,
                              levels = 0:3,
                              labels = c("None", 
                                         "Alcohol only",
                                         "Other Drugs Only",
                                         "Alcohol and other drugs")))

teds_dr_hi <- teds_dr |> 
  filter(stfips == 15)
```

```{r}
# below answers this Q: Among treatment episodes discharged in Hawaiʻi in 2023, how are the type of service, the age at first use of the primary substance, and whether alcohol and/or other drugs were involved associated with the odds that the episode ended in completion, with each factor adjusted for the other two?
```

```{r}

dat <- teds_dr_hi |>
  filter(stfips == 15, disyr == 2023)

nrow(dat)  


# recode
dat <- dat |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ na_if(.x, -9)))

# missingness
dat |>
  summarise(across(c(reason, sub1, services, age, psource),
                   ~ mean(is.na(.x)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "var", values_to = "prop_missing")


# recode
# reason: 1 Completed, 2 Dropped out, 3 Terminated by facility, 4 Transferred, 5 Incarcerated, 6 Death, 7 Other
dat <- dat |>
  filter(reason %in% c(1, 2, 3)) |>
  mutate(completed = reason == 1)

nrow(dat)
count(dat, completed)


dat <- dat |>
  mutate(
    substance = case_match(
      sub1,
      2       ~ "Alcohol",
      3       ~ "Cocaine/crack",
      4       ~ "Marijuana",
      c(5, 6, 7) ~ "Opioids", 
      10      ~ "Methamphetamine",
      c(11, 12) ~ "Other stimulants",
      .default = "Other"),
    service = case_match(
      services,
      c(1, 2, 8) ~ "Detox",
      c(3, 4)    ~ "Residential, short",
      5          ~ "Residential, long",
      6          ~ "Intensive outpatient",
      7          ~ "Outpatient"),
    referral = case_match(
      psource,
      1 ~ "Self/individual",
      7 ~ "Criminal justice",
      c(2, 3) ~ "Health care provider",
      .default = "Other community"),
    age_grp = case_when(
      age <= 3  ~ "12-20",
      age <= 5  ~ "21-29",
      age <= 7  ~ "30-39",
      age <= 9  ~ "40-49",
      !is.na(age) ~ "50+"))

# sanity check cell sizes BEFORE modeling
count(dat, substance, completed) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = completed, values_from = n)

# collapse anything too small to estimate, then set reference levels
dat <- dat |>
  mutate(
    substance = fct_lump_min(substance, min = 50, other_level = "Other"),
    substance = fct_relevel(substance, "Methamphetamine"),  # largest group in HI!
    service   = fct_relevel(factor(service), "Outpatient"),
    referral  = fct_relevel(factor(referral), "Self/individual"),
    age_grp   = factor(age_grp)) |>
  drop_na(completed, substance, service, referral, age_grp)

nrow(dat)   # how many rows did listwise deletion cost?


# completion rate by substance
dat |>
  group_by(substance) |>
  summarise(n = n(), pct_completed = mean(completed) * 100) |>
  arrange(desc(pct_completed))

# Plot
dat |>
  group_by(substance) |>
  summarise(pct = mean(completed), n = n()) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fct_reorder(substance, pct), y = pct)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Completed treatment",
       title = "Completion rate by primary substance, Hawaiʻi 2023")

# is substance confounded with service type? 
dat |>
  count(substance, service) |>
  group_by(substance) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  select(-n) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = service, values_from = prop)


chisq.test(table(dat$substance, dat$completed))

# model
m_unadj <- glm(completed ~ substance, family = binomial, data = dat)

m_adj   <- glm(completed ~ substance + service + age_grp + referral, family = binomial, data = dat)

summary(m_adj)

# does substance matter as a whole, after the other variables?
drop1(m_adj, test = "LRT")

# odds ratios with 95% CIs, unadjusted vs. adjusted side by side
or_table <- function(m, label) {
  broom::tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE) |>
    filter(str_detect(term, "^substance")) |>
    transmute(term = str_remove(term, "substance"),
              !!label := sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high))
}

left_join(or_table(m_unadj, "Unadjusted OR"),
          or_table(m_adj,   "Adjusted OR"),
          by = "term")


# sanity check for any huge SEs? (sign of separation / empty cells, as with alcdrug "None")
broom::tidy(m_adj) |> filter(std.error > 2)

# predicted probabilities are easier to explain than ORs
dat |>
  mutate(p_hat = predict(m_adj, type = "response")) |>
  group_by(substance) |>
  summarise(observed = mean(completed), predicted = mean(p_hat))




```

```{r}

teds_hi_d <- TEDSD_PUF_2023 |>
  clean_names() |>
  filter(stfips == 15) |>
  select(prior_treatment = noprior, education = educ, employment = employ,
         income = priminc, cj_referral = detcrim, insurance = hlthins,
         living = livarag, psych_problem = psyprob, marital = marstat, arrests)

teds_hi_d[teds_hi_d == -9] <- NA

vars <- names(teds_hi_d)
heat <- expand.grid(var1 = vars, var2 = vars, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
heat$cramers_v <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(heat)) {
  tab <- table(teds_hi_d[[heat$var1[i]]], teds_hi_d[[heat$var2[i]]])
  chi <- chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)$statistic
  heat$cramers_v[i] <- sqrt(chi / (sum(tab) * (min(dim(tab)) - 1)))
}

ggplot(heat, aes(x = factor(var1, levels = vars),
                 y = factor(var2, levels = rev(vars)),
                 fill = cramers_v)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(cramers_v, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red4", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Cramér's V",
       title = "Hawaii only: how strongly each pair is linked",
       subtitle = "Top row = link to prior treatment")
```

```{r}
teds_hi_d <- TEDSD_PUF_2023 |>
  clean_names() |>
  filter(stfips == 15) |>
  select(prior_treatment = noprior, age, insurance = hlthins,
         payer = primpay, not_in_labor = detnlf, employment = employ,
         meth = mthamflg, income = priminc, diagnosis = dsmcrit,
         referral = psource, use_freq = freq1, frstuse1)

teds_hi_d[teds_hi_d == -9] <- NA

vars <- names(teds_hi_d)
heat <- expand.grid(var1 = vars, var2 = vars, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
heat$cramers_v <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(heat)) {
  tab <- table(teds_hi_d[[heat$var1[i]]], teds_hi_d[[heat$var2[i]]])
  chi <- chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)$statistic
  heat$cramers_v[i] <- sqrt(chi / (sum(tab) * (min(dim(tab)) - 1)))
}

ggplot(heat, aes(x = factor(var1, levels = vars),
                 y = factor(var2, levels = rev(vars)),
                 fill = cramers_v)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(cramers_v, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red4", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Cramér's V",
       title = "Hawaii only: top 10 predictors of prior treatment",
       subtitle = "Top row = link to prior treatment")
```
